title: Accessibility statement
translationNotice: This is an English translation provided for convenience; the German version is legally binding.
intro: This statement applies to the web application “AI Stock Analyzer” accessible at [domain.tld]. As provider, we are obliged under the German Accessibility Strengthening Act (BFSG) to offer online services to consumers in an accessible way and to transparently report on the current state of accessibility.
conformanceBody: Our technical reference is the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at conformance level AA. The application is largely compliant with these requirements. The content listed below is not yet fully accessible; we are working on improvements.
nonConformingHeading: Content that is not fully accessible

charts.title: Interactive charts
charts.body: (lightweight-charts): the price charts, candlestick views and indicator panes are currently not described by screen readers. The underlying numbers are available in tabular form as an alternative (e.g. on the analysis page under “Fundamentals” and “Pro Scores”).

heatmaps.title: Heatmaps
heatmaps.body: (correlation matrix, monthly returns): the numeric value of every cell is exposed as an aria-label, but the colour gradient remains the dominant cue.

palette.title: Command palette (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K)
palette.body: : fully keyboard-operable with labels, but the live ticker search has not yet been fully annotated according to the WAI-ARIA combobox pattern.

pdf.title: Third-party PDF content
pdf.body: (financial magazine uploads, printed portfolio reports): not available in a screen-reader-optimised format; the AI-extracted recommendations, however, are rendered in structured, accessible HTML.

measures.skipLink: Skip link “Skip to main content” at the top of every page (WCAG 2.4.1).
measures.focus: Visible keyboard focus via :focus-visible on all interactive elements (WCAG 2.4.7). Focused elements are not hidden behind the fixed navigation (scroll-padding-top, WCAG 2.4.11).
measures.targetSize: Target size: every icon button has at least 24 × 24 CSS pixels of click area (WCAG 2.5.8).
measures.forms: Forms: every field has a programmatically associated label; errors are marked with aria-invalid and aria-describedby and announced via role="alert" (WCAG 3.3.1, 3.3.3, 4.1.3).
measures.status: Status messages: success and error messages are reported to screen readers via role="status" or role="alert" respectively (WCAG 4.1.3).
measures.tickerLinks: Standalone ticker links (in the market ticker and gainers/losers tables) carry a speakable aria-label with name, price and change instead of just the symbol (WCAG 2.4.4).
measures.color: Colour is never the only cue: gains/losses and signal states are also indicated by symbols (↑/↓/−) and signs (+/−) (WCAG 1.4.1).
measures.pageTitle: Page title: every route sets a unique document.title (WCAG 2.4.2).
measures.responsive: Responsive layout, legible from phone to desktop, zoom up to 200 % without loss of functionality (WCAG 1.4.4, 1.4.10).
measures.motion: Reduced motion: market ticker and other animations honour prefers-reduced-motion (WCAG 2.3.3).
measures.lang: The page language is declared in {tag} (WCAG 3.1.1).
